description:
The trails wind through forested areas with an open area where logging has occured. There are many views of Shuswap Lake and surounding areas. The trails climb to and elevation of 1249 m approx. There was a forest fire over some of these trails in 2023, but the trail has been fully rehabilitated - complete in 2026.

This trail is maintained by the Columbia-Shuswap Regional District. More trail information can be found at https://shuswaptrails.com/trails
directions: From Sorrento, travel west on highway 1, and turn left on Elson Road. Carry on and turn left on South Shore Place. Trail head location Lat 50�52'27.81"N, Long 119�30'54.37"W
title: Mount Baldy Trail
